items.information: WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OsanSummer2025#60081-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OsanSummer2025#60080-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OsanSummer2025#60081-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OsanSummer2025#60080-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.name: SacMini 2025
items.information: ## Registration is now full and we are now utilizing a waitlist system. Please view the [Waitlist tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacMini2025#60106-waitlist) for details. ![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) #### SacCubing's first ever mini competition is here, presenting SacMini 2025! * *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* * We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. * All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.
